artifacts.summary: Blocked handoff: build-verified soundness gap in key fuel-induction
Compiling Lean counterexample refuting the satisfiability-lifting obligation

partial_progress.details: Reduced key fuel-induction to 3 obligations; 2 are mathematically false for carried worklist branches (build-verified counterexample). Root cause: shared acc + per-branch fresh-world numbering. Requires definitional change, out of scope. File reverted to baseline.

memory_candidates: CSLib modal K tableau (Soundness.lean): modalExpandBranches uses a SHARED Accessibility `acc` across all worklist branches while modalApplyOne numbers fresh worlds PER-BRANCH via modalNextWorld. This causes cross-branch edge pollution: a diamond/boxNeg edge (w, modalNextWorld b) created in one branch is visible to sibling branches whose modalNextWorld equals that target, breaking the per-branch accFreshInv that modalStepBranch_preserves_sat requires. The key soundness invariant is therefore not maintainable without a definitional change (per-branch acc OR global fresh-world counter).

Lean proof technique: to refute a 'satisfiability is preserved under adding an accessibility edge' obligation, use bp = [T(box p)@0, T(box (p->bot))@0]: satisfiable at a dead-end world, unsatisfiable once that world gains a successor (forces p and not-p).
